program.name: Bar EMOM Ladder
program.subject: Pull-ups
program.blurb: More pull-ups without failing: a ladder one day, an EMOM the next, then a strength block.
program.about: Two ways to pile up pull-ups without ever failing a rep. One day climbs a ladder of pull-ups and push-ups; the other is a pull-up EMOM with a row. A short strength block for the legs or the rear shoulders follows each. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
